title: University Physics Volume 1 11.2 Angular Momentum
text:
The intent of choosing the direction of the angular momentum to be perpendicular to the plane containing r→r→ and p→p→ is similar to choosing the direction of torque to be perpendicular to the plane of r→andF→,r→andF→, as discussed in Fixed-Axis Rotation. The magnitude of the angular momentum is found from the definition of the cross-product,
This equation is analogous to the magnitude of the linear momentum p=mvp=mv. The direction of the angular momentum vector is directed along the axis of rotation given by the right-hand rule.
